indicator_name: CPI inflation (annual average), percent — world economies (World Bank WDI FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG)
description: Инфляция (ИПЦ, среднегодовая), % — страны мира (Всемирный банк, WDI)
methodology: Item = ISO3. IMF IFS-based; 1990s gaps: none for Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan; Kazakhstan from 1994, Kyrgyzstan from 1996. Known errors: Azerbaijan 1992 -10.6% (CIS Stat +912%), Armenia 1994 3 374% (CIS Stat 4 962%). For the CIS prefer CIS_* datasets. WDI last updated 2026-07-13.
